prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1039; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Reported symptoms included neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism for this type of impact. Over the course of care, the patient attended 17 visits for conservative management, including manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and home exercise instruction. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with the clinical course progressing gradually. Cervical examination showed reduced range of motion and paraspinal tenderness that support the reported injury, while neurological screening and certain imaging-related assessments returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single entries for each service, with no repeated charges. Current status is improving, and further follow-up has been recommended as needed.
